name: jarvis-k
description: A typed, supervised Windows desktop agent runtime.

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:core && npm run build:ui && npm run build:desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:boundaries && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:core && vitest run
